needs_human.note: An upload extracts EXIF immediately, and an upload over a reused row deletes the old row even when the new file has no EXIF (upload.py:355-360).; A copy duplicates the source's EXIF row, GPS included and across drives, without reading the copied file (fileops.py:298-313).; TIFF files with EXIF tags now get file_exif rows, now pinned by a test but still with no approved spec (exif.py:69-72).; Image formats with no _getexif, such as BMP and GIF, now return None without the warning they used to log, a log-only change.; A SVG or other .image-classified file Pillow cannot open now logs an 'EXIF extraction failed' warning at upload as well as at scan, a log-only change, if such a file reaches upload.py:308; the classification was not traced.

The tests' UNSPEC comment says a photo has its EXIF at once however it got into the library. No spec backs this. docs/specs has no entry for it according to the r1 record, which I did not recheck.; TIFF files now gain file_exif rows and a Photo Info section, and the TIFF row in the test now pins this as intended behavior.; Upload still replaces or deletes the file_exif row on a reused row, including removing it when the new photo has no EXIF.; Copy still duplicates the source's file_exif row, GPS included, without reading the copied bytes.
